content.title: Chapter 14 - ANIMALS — Sec. 14-128. - Feeding wildlife prohibited.
content.summary:

faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any person to feed, provide food, or assist another person
               in the feeding of wildlife or any wild animal in, from, or upon any park or golf course
               within the city.
Exception: Bird feeders may be placed on a park or golf course within the city with
               the prior written approval of the manager of parks for the city or for the North Jeffco
               Metropolitan Park and Recreation District, as applicable.
(
Ord. No. 4110, § 3, 4-21-2008
)
